notes: Raspberry Pi 5 soakee on a TCP link: the image connects to the bench bridge on the workstation, which passes its frames to fprime-yamcs; the image is started with `-a 192.168.10.1 -p 50000` and reads `PrmDb.dat` from its working directory; flash copies the committed `test/int/bench/PrmDb.dat`, built from `PiSensor/project/config/PrmDb.json`. The bench has no serial device (`uart` is null). The unit has no debugger: flash copies the image over ssh and starts it, and the serial is the Pi serial number of /proc/cpuinfo. Run fth from the campaign root on the workstation: `uut` is the checkout of this repository, `yamcs-config` the YAMCS configuration directory of ground/README.md, and python3 (with yamcs-client) and fprime-yamcs are on PATH. This recipe is for an image built for coverage: its counts stay on the Pi under gcda/ and are copied off with `collect-gcda` after `stop`.
